int integer_value(string text)
    return int(text)

int cents(string text)
    parts := text.split(".")
    return 100 * integer_value(parts[0]) + integer_value(parts[1])

string money(int value)
    return "{value / 100}.{value % 100:02.}"

bool leap(int year)
    return year % 4 == 0 and (year % 100 != 0 or year % 400 == 0)

int month_length(int year, int month)
    lengths := [31, 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31]
    return lengths[month - 1] + (if month == 2 and leap(year) then 1 else 0)

int day_number(string text)
    year := integer_value(text[:<4])
    month := integer_value(text[5:<7])
    day := integer_value(text[8:])
    if year < 2000 or year > 2099 or month < 1 or month > 12
        return -1
    if day < 1 or day > month_length(year, month)
        return -1
    result := day - 1
    for: 2000 <= prior < year
        result += if leap(prior) then 366 else 365
    for: 1 <= prior < month
        result += month_length(year, prior)
    return result

string date_text(int day)
    year := 2000
    while day >= (if leap(year) then 366 else 365)
        day -= if leap(year) then 366 else 365
        year += 1
    month := 1
    while day >= month_length(year, month)
        day -= month_length(year, month)
        month += 1
    return "{year:04.}-{month:02.}-{day + 1:02.}"

string date_weekday(int day)
    return date_text(day) + " " + ["SAT", "SUN", "MON", "TUE", "WED", "THU", "FRI"][day % 7]

int type_id(string text)
    names := ["SINGLE", "DOUBLE", "SUITE"]
    for: 0 <= k < 3
        if names[k] == text
            return k
    return -1

string type_name(int kind)
    return ["SINGLE", "DOUBLE", "SUITE"][kind]

string status_name(int status)
    return ["booked", "inhouse", "checkedout", "cancelled", "noshow"][status]

class Room(int number, int kind, int rate, bool dirty, int inhouse)
class Season(int first, int last, int percentage)
class Booking(string id, string guest, bool created, int room, int kind, int arrival, int departure, int status, int nights, int extras, int deposit, int paid, int posting, int fee, int penalty_day, int penalty, int[] bill, int extra_head, int extra_tail)
    expiry := arrival
class Extra(string name, int amount, int next)
class Ranked(int index, int day, string id)
class State()
    today := day_number("2026-01-01")
    rooms := array(50, fill = Room(0, 0, 0, false, -1))
    room_used := 0
    seasons := array(1000, fill = Season(0, 0, 100))
    season_used := 0
    bookings := array(300, fill = Booking("", "", false, -1, 0, 0, 0, -2, 0, 0, 0, 0, -1, 0, -1, 0, array(6, fill = 0), -1, -1))
    id_used := 0
    creation_order := array(300, fill = 0)
    created_used := 0
    waiting := array(300, fill = 0)
    wait_used := 0
    bool[][] blocked := array(50, fill = array(36525, fill = false))
    int[][] occupied := array(50, fill = array(36525, fill = -1))
    int[][] night_rooms := array(300, fill = array(30, fill = -1))
    int[][] night_rates := array(300, fill = array(30, fill = 0))
    charges := array(1000, fill = Extra("", 0, -1))
    charge_used := 0

void emit(string text)
    println(text)

void fail(string reason)
    emit("ERROR " + reason)

int room_id(const State state, int number)
    for: 0 <= k < state.room_used
        if state.rooms[k].number == number
            return k
    return -1

int used_id(const State state, string id)
    for: 0 <= k < state.id_used
        if state.bookings[k].id == id
            return k
    return -1

int reservation_id(const State state, string id)
    index := used_id(state, id)
    return if index >= 0 and state.bookings[index].created then index else -1

int wait_position(const State state, string id)
    for: 0 <= k < state.wait_used
        if state.bookings[state.waiting[k]].id == id
            return k
    return -1

void remove_wait(State &state, int position)
    for: position <= k < state.wait_used - 1
        state.waiting[k] = state.waiting[k + 1]
    state.wait_used -= 1

int[] room_order(const State state, kind := -1)
    result := [for k := (0:<int(state.room_used))[] if kind < 0 or state.rooms[k].kind == kind then k]
    for: 1 <= k < int(#result)
        value := result[k]
        position := k
        while position > 0 and state.rooms[result[position - 1]].number > state.rooms[value].number
            result[position] = result[position - 1]
            position -= 1
        result[position] = value
    return result

bool lexical_before(string a, string b)
    int[] aa := a.codepoints()
    int[] bb := b.codepoints()
    count := if #aa < #bb then int(#aa) else int(#bb)
    for: 0 <= k < count
        if aa[k] != bb[k]
            return aa[k] < bb[k]
    return #aa < #bb

int[] reservation_order(const State state, status := -1, field := 0)
    Ranked[] entries := []
    for: 0 <= k < state.created_used
        int index := state.creation_order[k]
        entry := state.bookings[index]
        if status < 0 or entry.status == status
            day := if field == 1 then entry.arrival elif field == 2 then entry.departure else 0
            entries = entries.append(Ranked(index, day, entry.id))
    for: 1 <= k < int(#entries)
        entry := entries[k]
        position := k
        while position > 0 and (entry.day < entries[position - 1].day or (entry.day == entries[position - 1].day and lexical_before(entry.id, entries[position - 1].id)))
            entries[position] = entries[position - 1]
            position -= 1
        entries[position] = entry
    return [for entry := entries[] then entry.index]

int night_rate(const State state, int room, int day)
    percentage := 100
    for: 0 <= k < state.season_used
        if state.seasons[k].first <= day <= state.seasons[k].last
            percentage = state.seasons[k].percentage
    return state.rooms[room].rate * percentage / 100

int unavailable(const State state, int room, int first, int last, except := -1)
    for: first <= day < last
        index := state.occupied[room][day]
        if state.blocked[room][day] or (index >= 0 and index != except)
            return day
    return -1

int free_room(const State state, int kind, int first, int last, except := -1)
    for room := room_order(state, kind)[]
        if unavailable(state, room, first, last, except) < 0
            return room
    return -1

string range_error(const State state, string a, string b, bool stay, bool past, int limit)
    first := day_number(a)
    last := day_number(b)
    if first < 0
        return "invalid date " + a
    if last < 0
        return "invalid date " + b
    if past and first < state.today
        return "past date " + a
    if last < first or (stay and last == first)
        return "invalid range " + a + " " + b
    length := last - first + (if stay then 0 else 1)
    if limit > 0 and length > limit
        return "too long " + string(length)
    return ""

int lodging(const State state, int index)
    return state.night_rates[index][:<state.bookings[index].nights].sum()

void clear_nights(State &state, int index, int first)
    entry := state.bookings[index]
    for: first <= k < entry.nights
        state.occupied[state.night_rooms[index][k]][entry.arrival + k] = -1

void price_nights(State &state, int index, int room, int first, int last)
    arrival := state.bookings[index].arrival
    for: first <= day < last
        position := day - arrival
        state.night_rooms[index][position] = room
        state.night_rates[index][position] = night_rate(state, room, day)
        state.occupied[room][day] = index

string deposit_text(const Booking entry, int amount)
    return "deposit " + money(entry.deposit) + (if amount >= entry.deposit then " due " + money(amount - entry.deposit) else " refund " + money(entry.deposit - amount))

int total_paid(const State state, string guest)
    payments := [for index := state.creation_order[:<state.created_used][]
        if state.bookings[index].guest == guest then state.bookings[index].paid]
    return payments.sum()

string tier_name(int points)
    return if points >= 2000 then "GOLD" elif points >= 500 then "SILVER" else "BRONZE"

int[] calculate_bill(const State state, int index)
    entry := state.bookings[index]
    points := total_paid(state, entry.guest) / 100
    discount := if points >= 2000 then 10 elif points >= 500 then 5 else 0
    charge := lodging(state, index)
    reduction := charge * discount / 100
    subtotal := charge - reduction + entry.penalty + entry.extras
    tax := subtotal / 10
    return [charge, reduction, entry.penalty, entry.extras, tax, subtotal + tax]

void create_reservation(State &state, int index, int room, prefix := "")
    state.bookings[index].created = true
    state.bookings[index].room = room
    state.bookings[index].status = 0
    state.bookings[index].nights = state.bookings[index].departure - state.bookings[index].arrival
    state.creation_order[state.created_used] = index
    state.created_used += 1
    price_nights(&state, index, room, state.bookings[index].arrival, state.bookings[index].departure)
    entry := state.bookings[index]
    emit(prefix + "BOOK " + entry.id + " " + entry.guest + " room " + string(state.rooms[room].number) + " " + type_name(state.rooms[room].kind) + " " + date_text(entry.arrival) + " -> " + date_text(entry.departure) + " nights " + string(entry.nights) + " total " + money(lodging(state, index)))

void process_waitlist(State &state)
    position := 0
    while position < state.wait_used
        int index := state.waiting[position]
        entry := state.bookings[index]
        if entry.expiry < state.today
            emit("  WAITLIST " + entry.id + " expired")
            state.bookings[index].status = -2
            remove_wait(&state, position)
        else
            room := free_room(state, entry.kind, entry.arrival, entry.departure)
            if room >= 0
                remove_wait(&state, position)
                create_reservation(&state, index, room, "  ")
            else
                position += 1

void check_out(State &state, int index, int day, prefix := "")
    entry := state.bookings[index]
    if day < entry.departure
        position := day - entry.arrival
        state.bookings[index].penalty_day = day
        state.bookings[index].penalty = state.night_rates[index][position]
        clear_nights(&state, index, position)
        state.bookings[index].departure = day
        state.bookings[index].nights = position
    bill := calculate_bill(state, index)
    state.bookings[index].bill = bill
    state.bookings[index].paid = bill[5]
    state.bookings[index].status = 2
    state.bookings[index].posting = day
    state.rooms[entry.room].dirty = true
    state.rooms[entry.room].inhouse = -1
    emit(prefix + "CHECKOUT " + entry.id + " nights " + string(state.bookings[index].nights) + " lodging " + money(bill[0]) + " discount " + money(bill[1]) + " penalty " + money(bill[2]) + " extras " + money(bill[3]) + " tax " + money(bill[4]) + " total " + money(bill[5]) + " " + deposit_text(state.bookings[index], bill[5]))

int[] occupancy(const State state, int day, kind := -1)
    result := array(4, fill = 0)
    for: 0 <= room < state.room_used
        if kind >= 0 and state.rooms[room].kind != kind
            continue
        result[0] += 1
        if state.blocked[room][day]
            result[1] += 1
        index := state.occupied[room][day]
        if index >= 0
            result[2] += 1
            result[3] += state.night_rates[index][day - state.bookings[index].arrival]
    return result

string occupancy_text(int[] values)
    available := values[0] - values[1]
    return "rooms " + string(values[0]) + " blocked " + string(values[1]) + " occupied " + string(values[2]) + " rate " + (if available == 0 then "n/a" else string(values[2] * 100 / available) + "%")

string metrics(int available, int sold, int revenue)
    return "sold " + string(sold) + "/" + string(available) + " rate " + (if available == 0 then "n/a" else string(sold * 100 / available) + "%") + " revenue " + money(revenue) + " adr " + (if sold == 0 then "n/a" else money(revenue / sold)) + " revpar " + (if available == 0 then "n/a" else money(revenue / available))

void command(State &state, string line)
    words := line.split(" ")
    action := words[0]
    if action == "ROOM" or action == "RATE" or action == "CLEAN" or action == "BLOCK" or action == "UNBLOCK"
        number := integer_value(words[1])
        room := room_id(state, number)
        if action == "ROOM"
            if room >= 0
                fail("duplicate room " + words[1])
            elif type_id(words[2]) < 0
                fail("invalid type " + words[2])
            else
                state.rooms[state.room_used] = Room(number, type_id(words[2]), cents(words[3]), false, -1)
                state.room_used += 1
                emit("ROOM " + words[1] + " " + words[2] + " " + money(cents(words[3])))
            return
        if room < 0
            fail("unknown room " + words[1])
            return
        if action == "RATE"
            before := state.rooms[room].rate
            state.rooms[room].rate = cents(words[2])
            emit("RATE " + words[1] + " " + money(before) + " -> " + money(state.rooms[room].rate))
        elif action == "CLEAN"
            if not state.rooms[room].dirty
                fail("already clean " + words[1])
            else
                state.rooms[room].dirty = false
                emit("CLEAN " + words[1])
        else
            reason := range_error(state, words[2], words[3], false, true, 31)
            if reason != ""
                fail(reason)
                return
            first := day_number(words[2])
            last := day_number(words[3])
            if action == "BLOCK"
                for: first <= day <= last
                    if state.occupied[room][day] >= 0
                        fail("room unavailable " + words[1] + " " + date_text(day))
                        return
            count := 0
            for: first <= day <= last
                desired := action == "BLOCK"
                if state.blocked[room][day] != desired
                    state.blocked[room][day] = desired
                    count += 1
            emit(action + " " + words[1] + " " + words[2] + " -> " + words[3] + (if action == "BLOCK" then " added " else " removed ") + string(count))
        return
    if action == "SEASON" or action == "REVENUE"
        reason := range_error(state, words[1], words[2], false, false, 0)
        if reason != ""
            fail(reason)
            return
        first := day_number(words[1])
        last := day_number(words[2])
        if action == "SEASON"
            percentage := integer_value(words[3])
            state.seasons[state.season_used] = Season(first, last, percentage)
            state.season_used += 1
            emit("SEASON " + string(state.season_used) + " " + words[1] + " -> " + words[2] + " " + string(percentage) + "%")
        else
            emit("REVENUE " + words[1] + " -> " + words[2])
            amounts := array(7, fill = 0)
            counts := array(3, fill = 0)
            for: 0 <= k < state.created_used
                entry := state.bookings[state.creation_order[k]]
                if entry.posting < first or entry.posting > last
                    continue
                if entry.status == 2
                    for: 0 <= part < 5
                        amounts[part] += entry.bill[part]
                    counts[0] += 1
                elif entry.status == 3
                    amounts[5] += entry.fee
                    counts[1] += 1
                elif entry.status == 4
                    amounts[6] += entry.fee
                    counts[2] += 1
            names := ["lodging", "discount", "penalty", "extras", "tax", "cancellation", "noshow"]
            for: 0 <= k < 7
                emit("  " + names[k] + " " + money(amounts[k]))
            total := amounts[0] - amounts[1] + amounts[2:].sum()
            emit("  total " + money(total))
            emit("  checkouts " + string(counts[0]) + " cancellations " + string(counts[1]) + " noshows " + string(counts[2]))
        return
    if action == "TODAY"
        day := day_number(words[1])
        if day < 0
            fail("invalid date " + words[1])
        elif day < state.today
            fail("past date " + words[1])
        else
            emit("TODAY " + date_weekday(day))
            for index := reservation_order(state, 1, 2)[]
                if state.bookings[index].departure < day
                    check_out(&state, index, state.bookings[index].departure, "  ")
            for index := reservation_order(state, 0, 1)[]
                if state.bookings[index].arrival < day
                    fee := state.night_rates[index][0]
                    state.bookings[index].fee = fee
                    state.bookings[index].paid = fee
                    state.bookings[index].status = 4
                    state.bookings[index].posting = state.bookings[index].arrival
                    clear_nights(&state, index, 0)
                    entry := state.bookings[index]
                    emit("  NOSHOW " + entry.id + " " + entry.guest + " fee " + money(fee) + " " + deposit_text(entry, fee))
            state.today = day
        return
    if action == "BOOK" or action == "BOOKROOM" or action == "WAITLIST"
        if used_id(state, words[1]) >= 0
            fail("duplicate reservation " + words[1])
            return
        room := -1
        kind := -1
        if action == "BOOKROOM"
            room = room_id(state, integer_value(words[3]))
            if room < 0
                fail("unknown room " + words[3])
                return
            kind = state.rooms[room].kind
        else
            kind = type_id(words[3])
            if kind < 0
                fail("invalid type " + words[3])
                return
        reason := range_error(state, words[4], words[5], true, true, 30)
        if reason != ""
            fail(reason)
            return
        first := day_number(words[4])
        last := day_number(words[5])
        if action == "BOOKROOM"
            unavailable_day := unavailable(state, room, first, last)
            if unavailable_day >= 0
                fail("room unavailable " + words[3] + " " + date_text(unavailable_day))
                return
        else
            room = free_room(state, kind, first, last)
            if room < 0 and action == "BOOK"
                fail("no availability " + words[3] + " " + words[4] + " " + words[5])
                return
        index := state.id_used
        state.id_used += 1
        state.bookings[index] = Booking(words[1], words[2], false, room, kind, first, last, -1, 0, 0, 0, 0, -1, 0, -1, 0, array(6, fill = 0), -1, -1)
        if room >= 0
            create_reservation(&state, index, room)
        else
            state.waiting[state.wait_used] = index
            state.wait_used += 1
            emit("WAITLIST " + words[1] + " queued position " + string(state.wait_used))
        return
    if action == "AVAIL" or action == "STATS" or action == "OCCUPANCY" or action == "SCHEDULE"
        kind := -1
        offset := 1
        if action == "AVAIL"
            kind = type_id(words[1])
            if kind < 0
                fail("invalid type " + words[1])
                return
            offset = 2
        first := day_number(words[offset])
        last := first
        if action == "AVAIL" or action == "STATS"
            reason := range_error(state, words[offset], words[offset + 1], false, false, 31)
            if reason != ""
                fail(reason)
                return
            last = day_number(words[offset + 1])
        elif first < 0
            fail("invalid date " + words[offset])
            return
        if action == "AVAIL"
            emit("AVAIL " + words[1] + " " + words[2] + " -> " + words[3])
            for: first <= day <= last
                rooms := [for room := room_order(state, kind)[]
                    if unavailable(state, room, day, day + 1) < 0 then string(state.rooms[room].number)]
                emit("  " + date_weekday(day) + " free " + string(#rooms) + (if #rooms == 0 then "" else " " + rooms.join(" ")))
        elif action == "STATS"
            emit("STATS " + words[1] + " -> " + words[2])
            totals := array(3, fill = 0)
            for: first <= day <= last
                values := occupancy(state, day)
                available := values[0] - values[1]
                emit("  " + date_weekday(day) + " " + metrics(available, values[2], values[3]))
                totals[0] += available
                totals[1] += values[2]
                totals[2] += values[3]
            emit("  total " + metrics(totals[0], totals[1], totals[2]))
        elif action == "OCCUPANCY"
            emit("OCCUPANCY " + date_weekday(first) + " " + occupancy_text(occupancy(state, first)))
            for: 0 <= group < 3
                values := occupancy(state, first, group)
                if values[0] > 0
                    emit("  " + type_name(group) + " " + occupancy_text(values))
        else
            int[] arrivals := []
            int[] departures := []
            for index := reservation_order(state)[]
                entry := state.bookings[index]
                if entry.arrival == first and entry.status != 3
                    arrivals = arrivals.append(index)
                if entry.departure == first and entry.status <= 2
                    departures = departures.append(index)
            emit("SCHEDULE " + date_weekday(first) + " arrivals " + string(#arrivals) + " departures " + string(#departures))
            for: 0 <= stage < 2
                selected := if stage == 0 then arrivals else departures
                for index := selected[]
                    entry := state.bookings[index]
                    emit("  " + (if stage == 0 then "arrival " else "departure ") + entry.id + " " + entry.guest + " room " + string(state.rooms[entry.room].number) + " " + status_name(entry.status))
        return
    if action == "ROOMS"
        emit("ROOMS " + date_weekday(state.today) + " rooms " + string(state.room_used))
        for room := room_order(state)[]
            entry := state.rooms[room]
            situation := if entry.inhouse >= 0 then "occupied " + state.bookings[entry.inhouse].id elif state.blocked[room][state.today] then "blocked" else "vacant"
            next := -1
            for: 0 <= k < state.created_used
                int index := state.creation_order[k]
                if state.bookings[index].status == 0 and state.bookings[index].room == room and (next < 0 or state.bookings[index].arrival < state.bookings[next].arrival)
                    next = index
            text := "  " + string(entry.number) + " " + type_name(entry.kind) + " base " + money(entry.rate) + " tonight " + money(night_rate(state, room, state.today)) + (if entry.dirty then " dirty " else " clean ") + situation
            if next >= 0
                text += " next " + state.bookings[next].id + " " + date_text(state.bookings[next].arrival)
            emit(text)
        return
    if action == "LIST"
        status := 0
        for: 0 <= k < 5
            if status_name(k) == words[1]
                status = k
        order := reservation_order(state, status, 1)
        emit("LIST " + words[1] + " " + string(#order))
        for index := order[]
            entry := state.bookings[index]
            emit("  " + entry.id + " " + entry.guest + " room " + string(state.rooms[entry.room].number) + " " + date_text(entry.arrival) + " -> " + date_text(entry.departure))
        return
    if action == "QUEUE"
        emit("QUEUE " + string(state.wait_used))
        for: 0 <= k < state.wait_used
            entry := state.bookings[state.waiting[k]]
            emit("  " + string(k + 1) + " " + entry.id + " " + entry.guest + " " + type_name(entry.kind) + " " + date_text(entry.arrival) + " -> " + date_text(entry.departure))
        return
    if action == "GUEST"
        int[] selected := [for index := state.creation_order[:<state.created_used][]
            if state.bookings[index].guest == words[1] then index]
        if #selected == 0
            fail("unknown guest " + words[1])
            return
        emit("GUEST " + words[1])
        for index := selected[]
            entry := state.bookings[index]
            emit("  " + entry.id + " room " + string(state.rooms[entry.room].number) + " " + type_name(state.rooms[entry.room].kind) + " " + date_text(entry.arrival) + " -> " + date_text(entry.departure) + " " + status_name(entry.status) + (if entry.status <= 1 then " deposit " + money(entry.deposit) else " paid " + money(entry.paid)))
        paid := total_paid(state, words[1])
        points := paid / 100
        emit("  total paid " + money(paid) + " points " + string(points) + " tier " + tier_name(points))
        return
    if action == "CANCEL"
        position := wait_position(state, words[1])
        if position >= 0
            state.bookings[state.waiting[position]].status = -2
            remove_wait(&state, position)
            emit("CANCEL " + words[1] + " waitlist removed")
            return
    index := reservation_id(state, words[1])
    if index < 0
        fail("unknown reservation " + words[1])
        return
    entry := state.bookings[index]
    id := entry.id
    if action != "INVOICE"
        valid := if action == "MODIFY" or action == "CANCEL" or action == "CHECKIN" then entry.status == 0 elif action == "PAY" then entry.status <= 1 else entry.status == 1
        if not valid
            fail("invalid status " + id + " " + status_name(entry.status))
            return
    if action == "MODIFY"
        reason := range_error(state, words[2], words[3], true, true, 30)
        if reason != ""
            fail(reason)
            return
        first := day_number(words[2])
        last := day_number(words[3])
        room := entry.room
        if unavailable(state, room, first, last, index) >= 0
            room = free_room(state, state.rooms[entry.room].kind, first, last, index)
        if room < 0
            fail("no availability " + type_name(state.rooms[entry.room].kind) + " " + words[2] + " " + words[3])
            return
        clear_nights(&state, index, 0)
        state.bookings[index].room = room
        state.bookings[index].arrival = first
        state.bookings[index].departure = last
        state.bookings[index].nights = last - first
        price_nights(&state, index, room, first, last)
        emit("MODIFY " + id + " room " + string(state.rooms[room].number) + (if room == entry.room then " kept " else " reassigned ") + words[2] + " -> " + words[3] + " nights " + string(last - first) + " total " + money(lodging(state, index)))
    elif action == "CANCEL"
        days := entry.arrival - state.today
        first_rate := state.night_rates[index][0]
        fee := if days >= 7 then 0 elif days >= 1 then first_rate / 2 else first_rate
        state.bookings[index].fee = fee
        state.bookings[index].paid = fee
        state.bookings[index].status = 3
        state.bookings[index].posting = state.today
        clear_nights(&state, index, 0)
        emit("CANCEL " + id + " days " + string(days) + " fee " + money(fee) + " " + deposit_text(entry, fee))
    elif action == "CHECKIN"
        room := entry.room
        if entry.arrival != state.today
            fail("not arrival date " + id + " " + date_text(entry.arrival))
        elif state.rooms[room].inhouse >= 0
            fail("room occupied " + string(state.rooms[room].number) + " " + state.bookings[state.rooms[room].inhouse].id)
        elif state.rooms[room].dirty
            fail("room dirty " + string(state.rooms[room].number))
        else
            state.bookings[index].status = 1
            state.rooms[room].inhouse = index
            emit("CHECKIN " + id + " " + entry.guest + " room " + string(state.rooms[room].number) + " until " + date_text(entry.departure))
    elif action == "MOVE"
        room := room_id(state, integer_value(words[2]))
        if room < 0
            fail("unknown room " + words[2])
            return
        if room == entry.room
            fail("same room " + words[2])
            return
        remaining := entry.departure - state.today
        if remaining <= 0
            fail("no remaining nights " + id)
            return
        day := unavailable(state, room, state.today, entry.departure, index)
        if day >= 0
            fail("room unavailable " + words[2] + " " + date_text(day))
        elif state.rooms[room].inhouse >= 0
            fail("room occupied " + words[2] + " " + state.bookings[state.rooms[room].inhouse].id)
        elif state.rooms[room].dirty
            fail("room dirty " + words[2])
        else
            for: state.today <= night < entry.departure
                position := night - entry.arrival
                state.occupied[state.night_rooms[index][position]][night] = -1
                state.night_rooms[index][position] = room
                state.occupied[room][night] = index
            emit("MOVE " + id + " " + string(state.rooms[entry.room].number) + " -> " + words[2] + " nights " + string(remaining))
            state.rooms[entry.room].dirty = true
            state.rooms[entry.room].inhouse = -1
            state.rooms[room].inhouse = index
            state.bookings[index].room = room
    elif action == "EXTEND"
        last := day_number(words[2])
        if last < 0
            fail("invalid date " + words[2])
        elif last <= entry.departure
            fail("invalid range " + date_text(entry.departure) + " " + words[2])
        elif last - entry.arrival > 30
            fail("too long " + string(last - entry.arrival))
        else
            day := unavailable(state, entry.room, entry.departure, last, index)
            if day >= 0
                fail("room unavailable " + string(state.rooms[entry.room].number) + " " + date_text(day))
            else
                price_nights(&state, index, entry.room, entry.departure, last)
                state.bookings[index].departure = last
                state.bookings[index].nights = last - entry.arrival
                emit("EXTEND " + id + " until " + words[2] + " nights " + string(state.bookings[index].nights) + " total " + money(lodging(state, index)))
    elif action == "CHARGE" or action == "PAY"
        amount := cents(words[2])
        if amount == 0
            fail("invalid amount")
        elif action == "PAY"
            state.bookings[index].deposit += amount
            emit("PAY " + id + " " + money(amount) + " deposit " + money(state.bookings[index].deposit))
        else
            charge := state.charge_used
            state.charge_used += 1
            state.charges[charge] = Extra(words[3], amount, -1)
            if entry.extra_tail < 0
                state.bookings[index].extra_head = charge
            else
                state.charges[entry.extra_tail].next = charge
            state.bookings[index].extra_tail = charge
            state.bookings[index].extras += amount
            emit("CHARGE " + id + " " + words[3] + " " + money(amount) + " extras " + money(state.bookings[index].extras))
    elif action == "CHECKOUT"
        check_out(&state, index, state.today)
    else
        emit("INVOICE " + id + " " + entry.guest + " room " + string(state.rooms[entry.room].number) + " " + type_name(state.rooms[entry.room].kind) + " " + status_name(entry.status))
        if entry.status == 3 or entry.status == 4
            emit("  " + (if entry.status == 3 then "cancellation" else "noshow") + " fee " + money(entry.fee))
            emit("  total " + money(entry.fee))
            emit("  " + deposit_text(entry, entry.fee))
        else
            for: 0 <= k < entry.nights
                emit("  " + date_weekday(entry.arrival + k) + " room " + string(state.rooms[state.night_rooms[index][k]].number) + " " + money(state.night_rates[index][k]))
            bill := if entry.status == 2 then entry.bill else calculate_bill(state, index)
            emit("  lodging " + money(bill[0]))
            emit("  discount " + money(bill[1]))
            if entry.penalty_day >= 0
                emit("  penalty " + date_weekday(entry.penalty_day) + " " + money(bill[2]))
            cursor := entry.extra_head
            while cursor >= 0
                charge := state.charges[cursor]
                emit("  extra " + charge.name + " " + money(charge.amount))
                cursor = charge.next
            emit("  tax " + money(bill[4]))
            emit("  total " + money(bill[5]))
            emit("  " + deposit_text(entry, bill[5]))
